results.title: 10 more parliamentary committees constituted
results.description: None of the 10 newly announced committees has an opposition lawmaker as its chairperson.

results.title: Zelensky: Partners say Ukraine is getting stronger on battlefield
results.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that European and U.S. partners have noted Ukraine's strengthening on the battlefield. According to him, this gives Ukraine greater confidence in any format of future discussions, including with Russia.

results.title: Lawler disagrees with Trump on Iran war: 'It is certainly not small potatoes'
